name: Case Study
description: Single-page Letter customer story. The light-blue hero band carries the logo, customer name and a pill label, then a two-tone outcome headline and a strip of 2-4 result metric cards; below it three two-column bands hold a bold summary beside the business challenge, a numbered "why" list beside the implementation steps, and a pull quote beside an info-icon conclusion callout. An optional call to action and the brand footer (logo, website / phone, social icons) close the page.
bestFor: Customer success stories and references: one named customer, hard outcome numbers, a before/after narrative and a quote. Pick this over stats-highlight when the source is about one customer's results rather than the product in general.
guidance: One page only, and it is a tight page. Total budget is about 320-360 words; the hero, all three bands, the optional CTA and the footer have to fit together.
eyebrow: shown as the pill label at the top right of the hero, 1-3 words, e.g. "Customer story".

title + title_accent read as one outcome headline, 8-14 words in all; put the 1-4 word payoff (usually the timeframe or result) in title_accent, shown in blue. subtitle: one sentence, at most 14 words.
results: 2-4 cards. Use only figures the source states; never round, extrapolate or invent one. A non-numeric milestone is fine if the source gives it. value at most 3 words, label at most 9 words.

summary: 35-50 words, set bold, and prefer the longer end. It sits beside the challenge list, so a short summary leaves a visible hole in the left column. Name the customer, what they do, who else was involved and the headline result.
challenge: 3-5 bullets, each at most 15 words, describing the situation before Salesmessage.
why: heading at most 3 words, or it wraps and knocks the two lists out of alignment. 3-5 numbered reasons, each at most 12 words, phrased as capabilities the customer valued.
implementation: 3-5 bullets, each at most 18 words, in the order the process actually runs.
quote: verbatim from the source only, at most 32 words. Leave text, author and role empty if the source has no quote; the block is then omitted.
conclusion: at most 34 words, restating the outcome and crediting anyone the source credits. Do not introduce facts that appear nowhere else.
cta: optional. Leave headline empty to drop it, which is usually right for a reference a customer will see, and buys room for longer bullets. Green is only ever this one button.
With 5 bullets in all three lists you are at the limit: if the render overflows, cut the weakest bullet from the longest list before shortening anything else.
Every number, name and quote must come from the source document.

eyebrow.description: Pill label at the top right of the hero, e.g. "Customer story", 1-3 words.

customer.description: Customer name shown beside the Salesmessage logo, 1-4 words, or empty.

title.description: Outcome-led headline without its last words, which go in title_accent; 8-14 words together.

title_accent.description: Last 1-4 words of the headline, shown in Salesmsg Blue, or empty.

subtitle.description: One sentence naming who did it and how, at most 14 words.

results.description: 2-4 headline metrics shown in the hero. Only numbers the source states.

value.description: Short figure, at most 3 words, e.g. "~$1.5M" or "70+".

label.description: What the figure counts, at most 9 words.

summary.description: Bold opening paragraph: who the customer is and what they achieved, 35-50 words.

bullets.description: 3-5 bullets on the problem before Salesmessage.

heading.description: Section heading, at most 3 words, e.g. "Why Salesmessage"; longer headings wrap.

items.description: 3-5 numbered reasons the customer chose Salesmessage.

heading.description: Section heading, 2-4 words, e.g. "Implementation and usage".

bullets.description: 3-5 bullets describing how it actually runs, in order.

text.description: Verbatim customer quote from the source, at most 32 words, or empty.

role.description: Their title and company, or empty.

text.description: Closing paragraph restating the outcome, at most 34 words.

headline.description: Call-to-action headline, at most 8 words. Empty to omit the CTA entirely.

text.description: One supporting sentence, at most 18 words, or empty.

url.description: Link from the source, or the brand website.
